rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone walks with their toes touching the ground.

example.english: I tiptoe past the bed because I'm afraid of waking my daughter.

rows.jyutping: heng1 sau2 heng1 goek3 gam3 haang4
rows.note: Use this when the important point is moving quietly, even if the sentence does not explicitly focus on the toes.

example.english: I tiptoe out the door quietly so I don't wake my family.
example.jyutping: heng1 sau2 heng1 goek3 gam3 haang4
